prompts.prompt: Create a production pixel-art animation sprite sheet for an original friendly amber fox companion named Ember. Transparent background. Sheet exactly 4 columns x 4 rows, square image, 16 equally sized square cells with generous transparent padding, no labels no grid no text. Each cell same fox body proportions, same position/ground baseline, same camera, limited 24-color palette, crisp pixel edges, no antialiasing, classic 32-bit game aesthetic. Cute orange russet fox, big triangular ears, cream chest, curled fluffy tail, explorer satchel, energetic confident expression. Full body fits entirely inside each cell. Row 1 idle breathing and slow blinking: 4 subtle consecutive frames. Row 2 greeting: 4 consecutive frames left paw rises, waves, lowers, neutral. Row 3 joy: 4 consecutive frames ears perk up, eyes happy crescent, slight hop, lands. Row 4 resting: 4 consecutive frames eyes closed, tail curled, tiny breathing. Absolute identity consistency, no body rotation, no scaling between frames. Frame cells fill ~60 percent of their width, aligned to cell centers and common bottom baseline. Real transparent alpha. This is a sprite asset, not an illustration or poster.
